incidents.symptom: After the successful Spark-1 A1/A2 capture, the remote CPU consolidator remained active during the high-dimensional pairwise JS reduction without producing the final summary within the operational window.
incidents.diagnosis: The raw label-free archives had completed and were independently verified; the remaining operation was offline A2 consolidation, not model inference.
incidents.repair: Stop the post-capture remote consolidator, preserve all 24 raw A2 files unchanged, transfer them with hashes, and rerun only the frozen consolidator locally on CPU.

note: No A2 radii, Gram eigenvalues, cosines, or qualification status were accepted before the consolidator and independent reference check were frozen and committed.
